findings.attack_path: Treat a blocked report as deployable because replay looks profitable.
findings.evidence: go-live verdict=BLOCKED; blockers=['4. Overfitting checks', '5. Paper matches backtest', '6. Risk controls + kill switch + data health', '7. Human approval']
findings.expected_damage: Capital allocated to an unproven edge.
findings.fix: Keep final verdict blocked until all gates clear.
findings.title: Backtest overconfidence

findings.attack_path: Use replay or open paper positions as resolved paper evidence.
findings.expected_damage: Live sizing before fill quality and drift are known.
findings.title: Insufficient paper evidence

findings.attack_path: Accept a surviving-name universe as live-like.
findings.evidence: delisted-inclusive point-in-time universe proof not present
findings.expected_damage: Inflated expectancy and understated drawdown.
findings.title: Survivorship bias

findings.attack_path: Use future-available symbols or corporate actions in validation.
findings.evidence: PIT universe validation is not proven in live-readiness dossier
findings.expected_damage: Hidden lookahead and false deploy verdict.
findings.fix: Add PIT source provenance and tests.
findings.title: Point-in-time data gap

findings.attack_path: Assume backtest fills match broker paper fills.
findings.expected_damage: Slippage and partial fills erase edge.
findings.title: Unrealistic fills

findings.attack_path: Rely on validation without checking the report exists and passes.
findings.expected_damage: Future data leaks into strategy selection.
findings.title: Hidden lookahead

findings.attack_path: Accept base costs but skip stressed costs.
findings.expected_damage: Edge vanishes once commissions/spread/slippage rise.
findings.title: Cost underestimation

findings.attack_path: Size up before observed slippage distribution exists.
findings.expected_damage: Stops and targets perform worse than expected.
findings.fix: Track slippage average and p95 in paper scorecard.
findings.title: Slippage underestimation

findings.attack_path: Deploy a strategy with large IS/OOS gap.
findings.evidence: go-live blockers=['4. Overfitting checks', '5. Paper matches backtest', '6. Risk controls + kill switch + data health', '7. Human approval']
findings.expected_damage: Strategy fails outside fitted regime.
findings.fix: Reduce parameter fragility and rerun walk-forward.
findings.title: Regime overfitting

findings.attack_path: Replace true paper sample size with replay sample size.
findings.expected_damage: Confidence is unsupported by live-like evidence.
findings.title: Sample-size weakness

findings.attack_path: Ignore broker rejection, partial fill, or unknown-status cases.
findings.expected_damage: Duplicate orders or unprotected positions.
findings.title: Execution weakness

findings.attack_path: Assume sandbox behavior from in-memory simulation only.
findings.evidence: paper broker forward evidence is still thin
findings.expected_damage: Live broker state diverges from internal state.
findings.fix: Add sandbox adapter evidence before live review.
findings.title: Broker integration weakness

findings.attack_path: Trust internal state after broker mismatch.
findings.expected_damage: Ghost/missing positions remain tradable.
findings.title: Reconciliation weakness

findings.attack_path: Allow an entry or fill without stop protection.
findings.evidence: protective-order tests and chaos incidents present
findings.expected_damage: Undefined downside and emergency manual repair.
findings.fix: Keep critical incident on stop attach failure.
findings.title: Stop-loss weakness

findings.attack_path: Ignore unreadable or engaged kill switch.
findings.evidence: config_guard and risk_gate check kill switch
findings.expected_damage: Orders continue through emergency halt.
findings.title: Kill-switch weakness

findings.attack_path: Accept stale, anonymous, or hash-mismatched approval.
findings.evidence: approval_status=[{'gate': '7. Human approval', 'status': 'FAIL', 'detail': 'approved is not true; approved_by is empty (need a named human); date is empty; cannot approve a system with no real paper track record (gate 5 not passing); reviewed_pack_sha is empty — set it to the current pack hash (171c857ddaec) to bind approval to the reports you reviewed'}]
findings.expected_damage: Live trading starts without accountable review.
findings.fix: Require named approver and current pack hash.
findings.title: Approval weakness

findings.attack_path: Incident or rejection occurs without durable audit trail.
findings.expected_damage: Cannot reconstruct fault or improve safely.
findings.title: Logging weakness

findings.attack_path: Show live-ready while the authority is blocked.
findings.expected_damage: Operator trusts a false green dashboard.
findings.title: Dashboard overclaiming

findings.attack_path: Let an agent invent quote, earnings, or confidence evidence.
findings.evidence: AI proposal schema/source validation is not yet complete
findings.expected_damage: Risk gate receives false facts.
findings.fix: Add strict AI proposal schema and source checks.
findings.title: AI hallucination

findings.attack_path: Summarize RESEARCH_ONLY as live-ready.
findings.expected_damage: Premature real-money deployment.
findings.title: Live-readiness overstatement
